item.title: When Being Righteous Isn't Enough
item.description: The Bible tells us Lot had influence, but he never used it to make a difference in his community. How about you? Are you making a difference?

item.title: How Japan and China's History Impacts Taiwan
item.description: Wars between the Chinese and Japanese span the centuries. Their animosity is understandable, given the ongoing brutal wars and conquests.

item.title: Why Trump's ICE Enforcement Refutes Claims of Authoritarianism
item.description: The Rule of Law does not end when enforcement becomes uncomfortable. It ends when laws are treated as optional.

item.title: 'Systemic Racism' Is Killing Black Americans ... Slowly?
item.description: A study purports to show that "systemic racism" is causing higher rates of sustained stress among black Americans and thereby shortening their lifespans.

item.title: Will 1A Come to Don Lemon's Aid?
item.description: The disgraced former CNN anchor and pseudo-journalist was rightly arrested for his role in storming a church, but does he have a case that his behavior is constitutionally protected?

item.title: The Movement to Overturn Obergefell
item.description: It's been a decade since this bad Supreme Court decision regarding marriage was handed down, and conservatives are pushing for change.

item.title: Monday Executive News Summary
item.description: Government enters partial shutdown, Dems flip GOP seat in Texas, Babylon Bee gets free speech win, Melania's documentary blows up critics' forecast, and more.

item.title: Hillary Clinton Berates Team Trump in Stunning Display of Empathy
item.description: She turned her ostensible Christianity into a blunt weapon to batter the MAGA movement for its supposed "savagery" and "cruelty."
